## Access Control  
### Authentication (Who You Are)  
**Customer Authentication:**
- Online Banking: Username/password + OTP (email/SMS)
- Mobile App: Biometric (fingerprint/face) + optional PIN
- Branch: Photo ID verification  
**Staff Authentication:**
- LDAP/Active Directory (username/password)
- MFA for privileged access (admin, compliance)
- Physical badges for facility access
- VPN required for remote access

raw_entities.name: Access Control Policy
raw_entities.description: Policy governing authentication and access control mechanisms for both customers and staff across online banking, mobile applications, branch operations, and remote access. Establishes multi-factor authentication requirements and physical security controls.

raw_entities.name: Customer Online Banking Authentication Requirement
raw_entities.description: Mandates that customers accessing online banking must authenticate using username/password combined with one-time password delivered via email or SMS.

raw_entities.name: Customer Mobile App Authentication Requirement
raw_entities.description: Requires customers using the mobile app to authenticate via biometric methods (fingerprint or facial recognition) with optional PIN as secondary factor.

raw_entities.name: Customer Branch Authentication Requirement
raw_entities.description: Mandates photo identification verification for customers accessing services at branch locations.

raw_entities.name: Staff Directory Authentication Requirement
raw_entities.description: Requires all staff to authenticate using LDAP/Active Directory credentials with username and password for system access.

raw_entities.name: Privileged Staff Multi-Factor Authentication Requirement
raw_entities.description: Mandates multi-factor authentication for staff with privileged access roles including administrative and compliance functions.

raw_entities.name: Staff Physical Badge Access Requirement
raw_entities.description: Requires staff to use physical badges for facility access control.

raw_entities.name: Remote Staff VPN Access Requirement
raw_entities.description: Mandates that staff accessing systems remotely must use a virtual private network (VPN) connection.

raw_entities.name: One-Time Password Authentication
raw_entities.description: Technical control implementing one-time password delivery via email or SMS for customer online banking authentication.

raw_entities.name: Biometric Authentication
raw_entities.description: Technical control implementing fingerprint and facial recognition authentication for mobile app access.

raw_entities.name: LDAP/Active Directory Authentication
raw_entities.description: Directory-based authentication system for staff system access using centralized username and password credentials.

raw_entities.name: Multi-Factor Authentication for Privileged Access
raw_entities.description: Technical control requiring multiple authentication factors for staff with administrative and compliance privileges.

raw_entities.name: Physical Badge Access Control
raw_entities.description: Physical security control using badge-based access to restrict facility entry to authorized staff.

raw_entities.name: Virtual Private Network Access
raw_entities.description: Network security control requiring encrypted VPN connection for remote staff access to systems.

raw_entities.name: Customer
raw_entities.description: End users accessing banking services through online banking, mobile applications, or branch channels, subject to authentication requirements.

raw_entities.name: Staff
raw_entities.description: Bank employees required to authenticate using directory credentials and comply with multi-factor authentication for privileged roles.

raw_entities.name: Privileged Staff
raw_entities.description: Staff members with administrative or compliance access roles subject to enhanced multi-factor authentication requirements.

raw_entities.name: Remote Staff
raw_entities.description: Staff members accessing bank systems from locations outside the physical facility, required to use VPN.
